failedGraders: judge:A Notifications page was just added under packages/app/react/src/routes/(app)/notifications/. Verify ALL of: (a) UI-COMPOSITION — the route index.tsx is a thin shell: the URL contract (validateSearch over the filter/page fields, category typed by the SDK NotificationCategory enum) plus layout composition only — no SDK hook calls, no business JSX; a Section component under -components/ owns the single useListNotifications query and maps the rows; row leaves receive the notification item via prop and never re-fetch it (a leaf owning the mark-as-read mutation is fine); repeated visual regions are decomposed into components, not inlined into one mega-component. (b) STATE-PLACEMENT — the category filter, unread-only toggle and page round-trip through the route search params (read via useSearch, written via navigate({ search: prev => ... })) so the filtered view deep-links; the clicked notification opens via useDialogStore show(<Dialog notification={item} />) and closes via hide() — the selected item is NOT mirrored into useState or a bespoke store, and there is ZERO useState under the new route dir (no mirroring of server data, mutation pending flags, filters, or dialog visibility). (c) MUTATION-IDIOM — mark-as-read uses the SDK mutation hook with success/settled invalidation of the list query key (listNotificationsQueryKey); in-flight feedback comes from the hook's own isPending flag; no try/catch around mutate/mutateAsync and no onError handler (the global MutationCache owns errors). (d) CENTRALIZE-MAPS + ENUM-REPR — category icon/color/variant resolve through a module-level Record keyed by the SDK NotificationCategory enum (no switch or if/else chain on category anywhere); human-readable category labels come from the i18n enums.NotificationCategory.* subtree with keys present in BOTH src/locales/pt.json and en.json — no hardcoded label strings in code. (e) LOCALE — the creation date renders with the active locale from useLocale() (toLocaleDateString(locale) or Intl bound to it) — never a hardcoded 'pt-BR'/'en-US'. Scope notes: ListNotifications takes NO category param on the wire — client-side category filtering over the fetched page is the EXPECTED shape; do not fail it for not sending the filter to the API. Local aliases of the dialog store actions (e.g. const showDialog = ...show) are fine — judge the idiom, not the variable name. Inspect the new files under src/routes/(app)/notifications/ plus src/locales/pt.json and en.json. The pre-existing Header notifications popover (src/components/Header/) is out of scope.
